IPF-proof-A-m3-M3.title: Minor third versus major third
IPF-proof-A-m3-M3.desc: Minor third versus major third. A keyboard from C4 to C5 with C4 as the shared root and the upper notes E♭4 (m3, 3 semitones), E4 (M3, 4 semitones) each in its own identity colour. A table lists what stayed (root C4) and what changed (upper note, semitone count, and the Plogger shape, shadow and fill where they apply).

IPF-proof-C-map.title: Thirteen-landmark keyboard map
IPF-proof-C-map.desc: A keyboard from C4 to C5 with all thirteen pitches marked, each in its own fixed identity colour, above an exact ruler from 0 to 12 semitones: P1 0, m2 1, M2 2, m3 3, M3 4, P4 5, A4/d5 6, P5 7, m6 8, M6 9, m7 10, M7 11, P8 12. IPF-onepage.title: Thirteen intervals on one page

IPF-onepage.teach: Row per interval: identity colour, notes, semitones, three Plogger marks.

IPF-invert.title: Inversion
IPF-invert.desc: Three inversion pairs on a keyboard from C4 to C5, each interval in its own identity colour. Minor third (3) becomes major sixth (9); major third (4) becomes minor sixth (8); perfect fourth (5) becomes perfect fifth (7). Each pair adds to 12 semitones and the interval numbers add to 9.
IPF-invert.teach: m3↔M6, M3↔m6, P4↔P5: semitones add to 12.

IPF-invert-narrow.title: Inversion (phone)

IPF-register.title: The same interval in three registers
IPF-register.desc: Three keyboards, each showing a perfect fifth of 7 semitones in its identity colour: C2 to G2 (low), C4 to G4 (middle) and C6 to G6 (high). The distance is identical; how it sounds depends on register, instrument and context.

IPF-intro-04.title: What is an interval? C4 to E4
IPF-intro-04.desc: A keyboard from C4 to C5 with C4 and E4 highlighted in the major-third identity colour and four numbered semitone hops between them: C to C-sharp, to D, to D-sharp, to E.

IPF-intro-05.title: Melodic versus harmonic
IPF-intro-05.desc: Two time strips for the same notes C4 and E4. In the melodic strip C4 sounds first and E4 second. In the harmonic strip both sound together for the whole span.
IPF-intro-05.teach: Same notes, one after another vs together.
